capabilities: Browse daily, weekly, and monthly notes in one scrolling timeline
Create notes for missing days via gap placeholder buttons
Show note excerpts and Dataview TABLE query summaries on cards
Jump to today's note from the ribbon or command palette
Configure date range, scroll chunks, and period markers
disambiguation: Not a time-tracking tool; it is a feed view over existing periodic notes, not a way to log time.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer; works with either the Periodic Notes plugin or the core Daily notes feature; README states it runs entirely offline with no analytics.
intentEvidence: A news-feed timeline for your Periodic Notes.
problem: Daily and periodic notes live in separate files, so reviewing a journal means jumping between files instead of scrolling through one continuous history.

relations.evidence: Weekly and monthly cards — period notes appear as full cards at boundaries when enabled in Periodic Notes
Optional: Dataview for TABLE query summaries on cards

summary: Feed-style timeline view that pulls daily, weekly, and monthly periodic notes into one continuous vertical scroll with newest entries first.
